overall: MARGINAL today, easing into a dry weekend
limiterDetail: The main limiter is current, with wind second. Decabaitot, Tara, Turda and Alava run 1.3–1.8 kt now and build to 1.5–1.9 kt around 4–6 PM. ECMWF wind is 8–13 kt now, peaking 11–15 kt from 10 AM to 3 PM, then dropping to 5–8 kt by 8–9 PM. Light drizzle this morning (up to 0.5 mm/h), dry tonight.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest: Tropical Cyclone Warning, Typhoon Rosal (Champi) Signal #2 and Signal #1, Fri 23 Oct 4:52 AM PHT, for the far north. Other recent items are flood advisories for Cagayan Valley (5:39 AM), Ilocos and the Cordillera (final), none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: No material change: Friday is MARGINAL as forecast, with arrivals at their thinnest today. The grounds snapshot is 0 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 2 VERY POOR (was 0 / 8 / 6 / 2). Cabunlawan slipped to POOR on 1.0 kt current and 12.5 kt wind; Decabaitot (1.8 kt) and Tara (1.5 kt) stay VERY POOR.

Next week shifted: the Mon 26 to Tue 27 rain eased to light (1.1 and 3.5 mm), and the wet day moved to Wed 28 (7.6 mm moderate). Thu 29 is now the windiest day (12 kt, gusts 20). The weekend stays dry and easy (Sat 7.3 kt, Sun 6.6 kt). PAGASA now lists Rosal as a Typhoon (Signal #2 and #1 at 4:52 AM PHT); nothing for Palawan.
